This is day three hundred sixty-five of Black Friday. We own forty-seven TVs.
It started like every year. Ninety percent off. But this year, the sale never ended.
A TV for nine dollars? I'll take ten!
Mom fights a grandma for the last toaster. The grandma wins.
Month two. Every shelf is empty. Stores lose money on every sale, so they close. Then the factories close.
Mom, can we buy a toaster?
So now we eat cold bread, in front of forty-seven TVs.
